project_name: UNILIS - Unified Learning and Innovation Lab Information System
description: Comprehensive feature inventory for the UNILIS LMS system including Traditional LMS, SmartLab (SmartLab), Live Engagement, Teams, and ICLM (Self-Paced Online Courses) modules.

modules.name: Traditional LMS
modules.description: Core learning management system with student, lecturer, and admin dashboards

features.name: Authentication System
features.description: Session-based email/password authentication with role-based access control (student/lecturer/admin)

features.name: Student Dashboard
features.description: Overview of enrolled units, announcements, upcoming deadlines, and grades summary

features.name: Student Assignments
features.description: View assignment details, submit work (text/file), track submission status

features.name: Student Grades
features.description: View graded assignments, unit grades, GPA calculation, and detailed feedback

features.name: Student Attendance Tracking
features.description: View attendance records per unit, mark attendance via QR/RFID/biometric/code

features.name: Course Content Access
features.description: Access course notes, lecture recordings, slides, and learning materials

features.name: Student Notifications
features.description: View announcements, assignment reminders, grade notifications, meeting invitations

features.name: Student Profile Management
features.description: Update personal info, change password, manage notification preferences

features.name: Lecturer Dashboard
features.description: Overview of teaching load, recent submissions, upcoming assessments, class announcements

features.name: Course & Unit Management
features.description: Create/edit courses, add units, set schedules, enroll students

features.name: Course Content Management
features.description: Upload lecture slides, recordings, notes; organize by week/topic

features.name: Assignment Creation & Management
features.description: Create assignments with rubric, instructions, deadlines; configure grading settings

features.name: Assignment Grading
features.description: View submissions, enter grades, provide feedback, AI-assisted grading

features.name: Online Meetings (WebRTC)
features.description: Schedule meetings, start WebRTC sessions, record meetings, share screen, live coding IDE

features.name: Attendance Management
features.description: View unit attendance reports, export records, set exemptions

features.name: File Requests
features.description: Request student files for grading/archival with deadline tracking

features.name: Exam & CAT Management
features.description: Create exams/CATs, generate questions, manage exam reports, export scores

features.name: Lecturer Practicals Management
features.description: Create and manage lab practicals via SmartLab integration (view, grade, monitor)

features.name: Admin Dashboard
features.description: System overview with user counts, active courses, system health, pending requests

features.name: User Management
features.description: Add/edit users, manage roles, enable/disable accounts, reset passwords

features.name: Institution Management
features.description: Add universities, manage departments, assign department heads

features.name: Course & Unit Administration
features.description: Add courses, configure units, assign lecturers, manage prerequisites

features.name: Pending Requests Management
features.description: Review and approve/reject team membership requests, file access requests, student appeals

features.name: Audit Logs
features.description: View system audit logs: user actions, logins, data changes, errors

features.name: Admin Reports
features.description: Generate reports: user statistics, course performance, system usage

modules.name: SmartLab Module
modules.description: Advanced laboratory management system with practicals, notebooks, asset tracking, biometric authentication, and blockchain audit trail

features.name: Multi-Modal Authentication
features.description: Six authentication methods: password, QR code, RFID, biometric, OTP, and session codes with MFA support

features.name: Practical Lifecycle Management
features.description: Complete practical management from experiment definition to grading with strict academic integrity workflow

features.name: Academic Integrity Workflow Engine
features.description: Strict state machine enforcing physical-presence-only attendance verification with 11 workflow states (Scheduled → Graded)

features.name: Attendance Verification (Multi-Method)
features.description: Mark attendance via Dynamic QR (15-sec refresh), RFID card, biometric fingerprint, technician code, or NFC

features.name: Datasheet Generation & Verification
features.description: Professional JKUAT-branded PDF lab datasheets with QR codes, SHA256 digital signatures, and public verification portal

features.name: Blockchain Audit Trail
features.description: Immutable blockchain-based audit trail for datasheet submissions (BlockchainAuditService) and legacy asset tracking (proof-of-work)

features.name: Digital Lab Notebook
features.description: Digital lab notebook system with versioning, approval workflow, group sync, and digital signatures on approval

features.name: Asset Management
features.description: Laboratory asset inventory management with blockchain-based immutable audit trail (issue/return/transfer/dispose)

features.name: Practical Request System
features.description: Students can request enrollment in practicals they missed or need access to, with admin approval workflow

features.name: Lab Scheduling & Calendar
features.description: Multi-view lab scheduling system with today/week/month/all views, lab filter, occupancy tracking, auth code generation

features.name: Inventory & Lab Monitoring
features.description: Lab inventory oversight and CO2 sensor monitoring via Python WebSocket server with real-time dashboard widget

features.name: Role-Based Dashboards
features.description: Custom dashboards per user role (student, lecturer, technician, admin) with relevant metrics, system health, and blockchain validation status

features.name: Audit & Logging
features.description: Comprehensive activity tracking across all system modules with 30+ action types logged to audit_logs table

features.name: Experiment Management
features.description: Structured experiment creation by technicians with sections, apparatus list, step-by-step procedures, and results table structure

features.name: Report Submission & Grading
features.description: Student report submission pipeline with draft/final workflow, file upload, grading with feedback, and revision requests

features.name: User Management (SmartLab)
features.description: Role-based user system with registration, staff management, lab assignment, and device fingerprint tracking

features.name: Student Practical Execution
features.description: Student-facing practical execution with tabbed interface, auto-save, structured data entry, and submission

features.name: Chemical Datasheet Management
features.description: Chemical safety datasheet management with search, PDF generation, and download capabilities

features.name: Docker & CI/CD Deployment
features.description: Containerized deployment with Docker Compose (Apache/PHP + MySQL), GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline, and production configuration

modules.name: Live Engagement Module
modules.description: Interactive live engagement module for presentations, polls, quizzes, whiteboards, word clouds, and real-time student participation

features.name: Presentation Management
features.description: Create, edit, and deliver interactive presentations with slide support (PDF, PPTX, images, video, HTML)

features.name: Live Polls
features.description: Create and manage live polls with multiple choice (up to 26 options), rating (1-10), and Likert scale types

features.name: Live Quizzes
features.description: Create and conduct live quizzes with time limits, multiple attempts (up to 3), scoring, and up to 100 questions

features.name: Interactive Whiteboard
features.description: Real-time collaborative whiteboard with drawing tools, multiple stroke colors/widths, and text tool (up to 5000 objects)

features.name: Word Cloud
features.description: Generate word clouds from participant responses with configurable stop words and up to 100 words

features.name: Live Session Management
features.description: Create and manage live engagement sessions with 8-char session codes, participant join, and auto-close on inactivity

features.name: Guest Authentication
features.description: Allow guest users to join live sessions without full account registration

features.name: Premium Design System
features.description: Modern glassmorphism design system with dark/light/high-contrast modes, WCAG AA compliance, and animated transitions

features.name: Real-time Engagement Features
features.description: Real-time polling, rate limiting, and reconnection handling for live sessions

modules.name: Teams Module
modules.description: Team management and collaboration features for group projects and team-based assignments

features.name: Team Management
features.description: Create and manage student teams, team membership requests, approvals, and export group members

features.name: Team Membership Requests
features.description: Student team membership request workflow with admin approval

Course Cards with Image, Description, Price

features.name: Business Certifications

features.name: Design Certifications

features.name: Marketing Certifications

features.name: Language Certifications

features.name: Featured Courses Carousel
features.description: Interactive horizontal carousel with scroll navigation for featuring top certification courses

features.name: Golden Theme Design
features.description: Warm golden/cream color scheme with serif typography, card-based layout, and hover effects

modules.name: Cross-Cutting Features
modules.description: Features that span across multiple modules

features.name: Email System
features.description: PHPMailer-based email system with templates, logging, retry mechanism, deadline reminders, and bulk sending

features.name: File Handling System
features.description: File upload, storage, and management across the system with type/size validation

features.name: Security Measures
features.description: Security implementations across the system including BCrypt hashing, SQL injection prevention, and XSS prevention

features.name: Deployment & DevOps
features.description: Docker containerization, GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline, production configuration, and database initialization

features.name: Data Validation
features.description: Client-side and server-side validation framework with sanitization and prepared statements

features.name: Testing
features.description: Automated testing infrastructure not yet implemented across the system

features.name: Performance Optimization
features.description: Performance optimizations needed across the system including indexing, caching, and asset optimization

features.name: Notification System
features.description: Multi-channel notification system with in-app and email notifications for various triggers

summary.note: Total features are top-level features (not counting sub-features). Sub-feature statuses are detailed within each feature.

known_issues: Practical attendance modal QR scanning not fully tested in browser
Lab session start flow and notebook editor integration need completion
Biometric enrollment flow not implemented in student profile
RFID card registration UI not implemented
WebRTC meeting system partially implemented (screen sharing incomplete)
Real-time notifications use AJAX polling instead of WebSocket
Audit logging not comprehensive for traditional LMS
No automated test suite across the system
File uploads stored in webroot (security concern)
API endpoints lack rate limiting and CSRF protection
Two separate authentication systems (traditional LMS and smart-lab) with different user tables
Admin reports and audit log viewing not implemented
ICLM module is currently a static HTML/CSS catalog (no backend enrollment, payment, or certificate generation)
recommended_next_steps: 1. Test practical attendance modal in browser (QR code, RFID, biometric, code)
2. Complete practical session flow (session start, notebook editor integration, grading)
3. Implement biometric and RFID enrollment flows in student profile
4. Complete WebRTC meeting system (screen sharing, recording)
6. Create comprehensive test suite (unit, integration, UI, API)
7. Implement security hardening (CSRF, rate limiting, HTTPS, security headers)
8. Optimize database queries and add caching layer (Redis)
9. Implement comprehensive audit logging across all modules
10. Complete admin reporting dashboard with export capabilities
11. Consolidate dual authentication systems into unified user management
12. Add backend functionality to ICLM module (enrollment, payment, certificate generation)
13. Set up monitoring, logging, and alerting for production
